meta.title: FUNAABSU Constitution
meta.subtitle: Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta Student Union

preamble.title: Preamble
clauses: We the entire students of the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta, Ogun State, Nigeria, having firmly, solemnly and unanimously resolved to initiate the growth of a virile, viable, unique, mature and responsible Student Union recognizing the need to contribute our quota to the terms of production of a constitution with the sole purpose of contributing our quota to the progress, unity and dignity of our fatherland and the human race as a whole, the aims and objectives mentioned herein and for the purpose of fostering unity, peace and progress, to enhance and foster our general welfare and the protection of our collective interest in identifying the unique role we have to play in the scientific, technological, cultural social, political and economic development of our fatherland in the realm of the constraints of our era and our role, in the enhancement of fair, open, progressive and appropriate educational system that will guarantee self-reliance and  egalitarianism in our society.

To work relentlessly for the maintenance of academic and sustainable utilization of resources throughout Nigeria, to provide a conducive and intellectual atmosphere, to provide the means by which we may adequately utilize the educational, cultural, intellectual and sporting activities in our era.

To equip ourselves toward the leadership challenge of this nation and to commit ourselves to the pursuance of the best ideals of the University, maintenance of cordial relationship with constituted authority and obedience to the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta, do hereby make, enact and give to ourselves through our representatives in the Parliament, the following constitution which shall become effective from the date it is approved by the Vice-Chancellor of the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta.

sections.title: NAME
sections.text: The Union shall be known, called and addressed as the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta Student Union (FUNAABSU).

sections.title: SUPREMACY OF THE CONSTITUTION
clauses: The constitution shall be supreme over all members of the Union, its officers as well as any organ of the Union.
The provision of the constitution shall be binding on any member of the Union or its organ.
It shall not be amended unless the provisions under the amendment clause are fully or adequately satisfied.

The constitution is supreme and its provisions shall be binding on all members of the Union save any aspect which is inconsistent with the provision of the schools rules and regulations provided such does not affect the composition, structure objectives and function of the Union.

sections.title: FUNDAMENTAL OBJECTIVES
clauses: To promote the spirit of oneness among the students of the University so as to subdue tribal, ethnic and religious bigotry.
To promote cordial relationship, awareness, amended understanding between students and the rest of the University community.
To protect the fundamental human rights of its members
To promote socio-cultural, intellectual and sporting activities of its members.
To promote cordial relationship between students and constituted authorities.
To promote friendly relationship with other student bodies in and outside Nigeria whose aim and objectives are acceptable to the Union.
To work for the progress and advancement of Agricultural, management, science and technology in Nigeria.
To embark on lawful activities under the rules and regulations of the University for the attainment of these aims and objectives.

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: MEMBERSHIP
clauses: Membership of the Union shall be voluntary and shall consist of the following categories:-
Ordinary members.
Associate members.
Honorary members.
Life members.

subsections.title: ORDINARY MEMBERS
clauses: Ordinary members of the Union
Shall be matriculated student of the University pursuing academic programmes of duration of not less than one academic year.
Shall have right to vote and to be voted for provided they meet other relevant provisions of this constitution.
Shall have the right to use facilities of the Union in line with regulations guiding the use facilities.
Shall have the right to participate in all accredited activities of the union except otherwise indicated.
Shall have the right to wear and display the official colors or emblem of the union.
Shall pay the prescribed annual due and satisfy other laid down registration procedures of the union.
All freshmen shall be entitled to a copy of the FUNAABSU constitution after payment of the prescribed fees.
Shall forfeit their membership of the union on completion of their programme or forfeiture of studentship.

subsections.title: ASSOCIATE MEMBER
clauses: Associate member of the Union;
Shall be non-matriculated student of the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta.
Shall have no right to vote or be voted for in union elections.
Shall have access to the facilities of the union in line with regulations guiding the use of such facilities.
Shall have the right to wear and display the official colors or emblem of the union.
Shall have the right to participate in all accredited activities of the union except otherwise indicated
Shall pay the prescribed dues and satisfy other laid down registration procedures of the union.
Shall be entitled to copy of the FUNAABSU constitution after payment of the prescribed fees.
Shall forfeit their membership of the union on completion of their programmes or forfeiture of studentship.

subsections.title: HONORARY MEMBERS
clauses: Honorary members of this union;
Shall be nominated by the FEC subject to 2/3 majority approval of the Senate.

Appointment shall be based on the individual’s outstanding interest in Student welfare and academic matters as relating to the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta ad contribution to the educational development in Nigeria.
Shall be appointed from the cream of Nigerians except otherwise approved by the JCA.
Shall be removed in line with provisions of Article One (10) of this constitution.

subsections.title: LIFE MEMBERS
clauses: Life members of this union
Shall be nominated by FEC subject to 2/3 majority approval of the Senate
Shall be nominated from among the past members of the union who must have had an outstanding record of achievement during his course of study in the University.
Shall be removed in line with provisions of Article one (10) of this constitution.

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: MEMBERSHIP RIGHTS
clauses: Membership right are alienated and should be respected by fellow student
Every student has a right to fair and equitable treatment by all student leaders.
No student shall be discriminated against, directly or indirectly, based on ethnic, social, origin, political, religion, disability or peer group within and outside the four walls of the University.
Every student is entitled to equal treatment and protection as provided for, in the regulation of the University.
Every student has right to write and/or submit petition(s) against union leaders, who shall carry out further actions on it.

sections.title: PATRONS/PATRONESS
clauses: There shall be patrons/patroness whom shall not be members of the union but:
Shall act in advisory capacity.
Shall be nominated by the FEC subject to 2/3 majority approval of the Senate
Shall possesses the following qualities;
Must be interested in the affairs of students.
Must have contributed meaningfully to the educational development of Nigeria.
Must be prepared to give adequate assistance to the union as circumstance(s) may warrant.
Shall have a renewable tenure of office of five (5) years.
Shall be removed in line with provisions of Article One (10) of the constitution.

sections.title: LIFE PATRON
clauses: Life patron of this union;
Shall be a traditional ruler of good repute or a philanthropist.
Shall be entitled to a copy of the FUNAABSU constitution after payment of the prescribed fees.
Shall possess all the qualities stated in article one S.10 of this constitution.

sections.title: ADVISERS
clauses: The Union shall have the following categories of advisers:
Legal advisers.
Academic advisers.
Other advisers who;
Shall advise the union from time to time
Shall be nominated by the FEC subjected to 2/3 majority approval of the Senate
Shall be removed in line with provisions of Article One S.10 of this constitution.

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: The legal adviser shall be a qualified legal practitioner of good repute.

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: The academic adviser shall;
clauses: Have adequate knowledge of the University’s academic, program.
Be an academician of good repute.
Have an understanding record of achievement

subsections.label: C
subsections.title: Other advisers shall;
clauses: Have contributed positively to the upliftment of student well-being.
Have contributed to the educational development of Nigeria
Be of good repute professionally.

sections.title: REMOVAL OF HONORARY, LIFE-MEMBER, PATRONS/PATRONESS AND         ADVISERS
clauses: Honorary and life-member, patrons and advisers shall stand removed if found guilty of public misconduct subject to 2/3 majority approval of the Senate
Shall stand removed on his/her death.
If he ceases to satisfy part(s) of the requirement on which he was appointed Subject to 2/3 majority approval of the Senate.
If he wishes to relinquish the post by formal notification to the union.

sections.title: VOTING RIGHT
clauses: No student who has not completed one session in the University shall be voted for, shall have the right to vote in all union elections, except otherwise indicated by provisions of this constitution.

sections.title: ORGANS OF THE UNION
clauses: The organs of the union shall consist of;
The Executive shall be referred to as the FUNAABSU Executive Council (FEC)
The Legislature shall be referred to as the Student Representative Assembly (SRA)
The Judiciary shall be referred to as the FUNAABSU Judicial Council (FJC)
The Joint Consultative Assembly(JCA)
The Congress

sections.title: THE EXECUTIVE
clauses: The Executive body of the Union shall be known and addressed as the FUNAABSU Executive Council (FEC). The day to day management of the Union shall be entrusted to the FUNAABSU Executive Council.

sections.title: COMPOSITION OF THE FUNAABSU EXECUTIVE COUNCIL
clauses: The FUNAABSU Executive Council shall comprise the following:-
President
Vice-president
General Secretary
Assistant General Secretary
Director of Socials
Director of Welfare and Business.
Director of Sports
Public Relations Officer
Director of Finance
Director of Treasury.

sections.title: ELIGIBILITY FOR FUNAABSU EXECUTIVE COUNCIL MEMBERSHIP
sections.text: All FEC Officers shall be opened to full time ordinary member who must have a minimum CGPA of not less than 2.6 except the President and the Vice-President who must have a minimum CGPA of not less than 3.0
clauses: In addition to the condition stated above, all FEC member;
Must have good knowledge of the Student Union Constitution.
Must not have been involved in any anti-union activities, misconduct, misappropriation of funds and fraud within and outside the University.

sections.title: FUCTIONS AND POWERS OF THE UNION OFFICERS

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: The President
clauses: Shall be the head and first member of the union
Shall defend the Union at all times.
Shall preside over all meetings of the FUNAABSU Executive Council.
Shall cast the deciding vote in the case of a tie.
Shall refer any act of violation of code of conduct by any member of the FEC to the Senate for appropriate action(s).
Shall be a co-signatory to the Union’s account.

Shall represent or delegate a representative to attend any official engagement of the union outside the University and report to the FEC within seventy-two (72) working hours of his arrival and to the Senate.
Shall direct and supervise all Union activities.
Shall present a monthly report stating the state of the Union to the Senate.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the provisions of this constitution.

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: Vice-President
clauses: Shall assist the President in discharging the duties.
Shall deputize for the President in his absence.
The Union week shall be organized and co-ordinated by the Vice-President, the social aspects of the week shall be handled by the office of the Director of Socials.
Shall carry out other functions as may be delegated by the President.
Shall perform other function(s) as may be directed by the provision(s) of this constitution.

subsections.label: C
subsections.title: General Secretary
clauses: Shall be responsible for all secretariat matters of the union.
Shall conduct and deal with official correspondence of the union.
Shall in conjunction with the President summon at least one statutory meeting of the FEC per month.
Shall be responsible for taking and keeping of minutes during the FEC meetings.
Shall summon an emergency meeting of the FEC at the request of the President or six (6) members of the FEC.
Shall work in conjunction with the relevant officers in compiling an annual report of the union activities during the tenure of the office and shall present same to the Senate.
Shall keep the register of visiting dignitaries.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the provision of this constitution.

subsections.label: D
subsections.title: Assistant General Secretary
clauses: Shall deputize and perform all the function of the General Secretary in his absence.
Shall be responsible for keeping attendance and any other relevant records of the FEC.
Shall be responsible for procurement and taking stock of the Union’s stationeries.
Shall carry out any other functions as may be directed by the President.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the provision(s) of this constitution.

subsections.label: E
subsections.title: Director of Socials
clauses: Shall be responsible for the supervision and co-ordination of all social activities of the union.
Shall carry out other functions as may be directed by the President.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the provisions of this constitution.

subsections.label: F
subsections.title: Director of Welfare and Business
clauses: Shall be responsible for all matters relating to the welfare of all members of the union.
Shall liaise with the Medical Unit of the University on matters relating to the health of members.
Shall be responsible for the Provision of refreshment for the Executive during meetings as the need arises.
Shall oversee the affairs of the bar, butteries and cafeteria of the union.
Shall ensure that price of goods and services are regulated within the campus.
Shall handle the production of material souvenirs in conjunction with the Senate ad-hoc committee on souvenirs.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the President.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the provision(s) of this constitution.

subsections.label: G
subsections.title: Director of Sports
clauses: Shall liaise with the University Sport Unit on all matters relating to sports.
Shall be responsible for the purchase and maintenance of all sport materials of the Union.
Shall be responsible for the provision of refreshment for participants during any sports activity (ies) organized by the union as the need arises.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the President.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the provision(s) of this constitution.

subsections.label: H
subsections.title: Public Relations Officer
clauses: Shall in conjunction with the President prepare a press release on behalf of the Union as at when necessary.
Shall be responsible for the arrangement of Press Conference(s) at the instance of the FEC.

Shall be responsible for the maintenance and co-ordination of the union ̛ s public opinion collection centre which shall be established in each Hall of Residence and Union secretariat. Such public opinion which shall be in writing and duly signed by the writer(s) shall be presented to the FEC within Forty eight (48) hours of receipt.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the president.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the provision(s) of this constitutio

subsections.label: I
subsections.title: Director of Finance
clauses: Shall oversee all financial matters of the union.
Shall in consultation with every officer of the FEC prepare the budget of the Union.
Shall collect all funds on behalf of the union, shall be liable for such money collected and turn same to the Director of Treasury not later than forty-eight (48) working hours of collection.
Shall issue receipt for all funds accruing to the Union’s purse.
Shall be responsible for the preparation of balance sheet and statement of account and present same to the FEC.
Shall be co-signatory to the Union ̛ s account.
Shall keep a copy of all financial document of the union.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the president.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the provision(s) of this constitution.
Shall be a co signatory to the Unions account

subsections.label: J
subsections.title: Director of Treasury
clauses: Shall keep an impress account of not more than Ten thousand naira (10,000) only.

Shall pay all money handed over to him by the Director of Finance to the Union ̛ s account not later than Forty-eight (48) working hours ad forward document in respect of same the Director of Finance.
Shall account for all funds received by him and shall be liable for misappropriation of such money.
Shall maintain proper records all income and expenditure of the union.
Shall in collaboration with the Director of Finance prepare the Union’s annual budget.
Shall be responsible to the FEC for disbursement of the approved expenditure.
Shall be co-signatory to the Union ̛ s account.
Shall carry out any other function(s) as may be directed by the provision(s) of this constitution.

sections.title: HALL EXECUTIVE
clauses: The Hall executive shall be responsible for the day-to-day running of the Halls Residence in line with the University laws and regulations.

sections.title: ELIGIBILITY FOR HALL EXECUTIVE MEMBERS
clauses: Shall be opened to full time ordinary members who are residents in Halls of Residence and must have a minimum CGPA of at least 2.6.
All of Hall Executive Council members;
Must have a good knowledge of the Student Union constitution.
Must not have been involved in any anti-union activities, misconduct, misappropriation of funds and fraud within and outside the University.

sections.title: FUNCTIONS AND POWERS
clauses: Shall operate in line with the FEC in compliance with the provisions for this constitution.
Shall send monthly situation reports to the Senate.
Shall operate within the territorial limit of their respective Halls
Shall have the power to set up ad-hoc or standing committees to perform specific function(s) relating to the effective management of the halls.
Shall have power to dissolve such committees.
Shall abide by the provisions of this constitution.

sections.title: COMPOSITION
clauses: The Hall Executive shall consist of the following:
Chairman/Chairperson
Secretary
Minister of Welfare
Minister of sports
Minister of Finance
Minister of Treasury.

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: CHAIRMAN/CHAIRPERSON
clauses: Shall be the Head of the Hall Executive Council.
Shall preside over all general and executive meeting(s) of the Hall.
Shall supervise and co-ordinate all the activities of the Hall
Shall represent or delegate a representative to all official engagement of the Halls within and outside the University.

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: HALL SECRETARY
clauses: Shall be responsible for all secretariat matters of the Hall
Shall conduct and deal with all official correspondence during executive and general meeting of the Hall.
Shall take and keep minutes during executive and general meetings of the Hall.
Shall compile an annual report of the activities of the Hall and present same to the Hall executive.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Hall Chairman.
Shall perform any other function as maybe directed by the provisions of this constitution.

subsections.label: C
subsections.title: MINISTER OF WELFARE
clauses: Shall liaise with the Hall wardens on all matters relating to the welfare of Hall members.
Shall take charge of activities of Halls’ week.
Shall ensure that prices of goods and services are regulated at Hall’s bars, butteries and cafeteria.
Shall report cases of extortion at the Halls’ bars, butteries and cafeteria to the Hall warden for appropriate actions.
Shall liaise with the Hall-Wardens to ensure that the Halls are kept clean at all times.
Shall be responsible for the provision of refreshment for the Hall executive during meetings.
Shall make transportation arrangement for Hall member during vacations.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegate by the Hall Chairman.
Shall perform any other function as may be directed by the provisions of this constitution.

subsections.title: MINISTER OF SPORTS
clauses: Shall co-ordinate and supervise all sporting activities of the Halls.
Shall take proper care of all sporting equipment’s of the Halls.
Shall organize sport competitions for the benefit of Hall members.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Hall Chairman.
Shall perform any other function as may be directed by the provisions of this chairman.

subsections.title: MINISTER OF SOCIALS AND INFORMATION
clauses: Shall be responsible for all social activities of the Hall.
Shall be responsible for the provision of recreational facilities for Hall members.
Shall conjunction with the Hall chairman prepare Press release on behalf of the Hall.
Shall be responsible for the care and maintenance of the Hall’s public relations equipment.
Shall be supervising the publication of the Hall’s weekly bulletin and newsletters.
Shall monitor the activities of the Hall for appropriate information dissemination.
Shall be responsible for maintenance of the Hall’s library.
Shall report cases of damaged electrical appliances to the appropriate authorities.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Hall Chairman.
Shall perform any other function as may be directed by the provisions of this constitution.

subsections.title: MINISTER OF FINANCE
clauses: Shall keep proper records of all financial matters of the Hall.
Shall in consultation with other Hall executives, prepare the annual budget of the Hall.
Shall collect all money on behalf of the Hall and shall be responsible for such money collected.
Shall issue receipts for all money accruing to the Hall’s purse.
Shall keep a copy of all documents of the Hall.
Shall be a co-signatory to the Hall’s account.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Hall chairman.
Shall perform any other function as may be directed by the provisions of this constitution.

subsections.title: DIRECTOR OF TREASURY
clauses: Shall pay all money handed to him by the Minister of Finance not later than Forty-eight working hours.
Shall keep a copy of all bank documents of Hall.
Shall keep an impress account of not more than 5,000 only.
Shall be responsible to the Hall executive for the disbursement of the approved expenditure of the Hall.
Shall issue receipts for all money disbursed by him.
Shall be co-signatory to the Hall’s account.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Hall Chairman.

subsections.label: J
subsections.title: HALL REPRESENTATIVE
clauses: There shall be hall representatives which shall be responsible for individual hall in the school and are to report situation of each hall to the Hostel Executives for proper actions.

subsections.title: ELIGIBILITY FOR HALL REPRESENTATIVE
clauses: Shall be open to full time ordinary members who are resident in the Hall.
Must be nominated by the hall executive and subject to the approval of 2/3 member of the Senate in such sitting.
Must not have been involved in any anti-activities misconduct, misappropriation of funds and fraud within and outside the University.
Freshmen are only eligible for the seat of the commission for special duties and the commission for information.

subsections.title: COMPOSITION
clauses: Mayor
Deputy Mayor.

subsections.title: FUNCTIONS OF THE HALL REPRESENTATIVES.
clauses: Mayor
Shall operate in compliance to the Hall Executives
Shall be responsible for maintenance of peace and order in each hall.
Shall notify the welfare director of faulty electrical appliance in the Halls
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Hall Chairman or Chairperson.
Deputy Mayor.
Shall deputize the mayor in performing his duties.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Hall Chairman or Chairperson.

sections.title: HALL COMMITTEES
clauses: There shall be committees which shall be saddled with the responsibility of helping the executive in specific areas. Member of such Committees shall be appointed by the Hall executives.

sections.title: COMPOSITION
clauses: Each committees shall consist of five(5) members headed by a Chairman and shall have a Secretary.
The committee shall consist of the following;
Committees on Welfare.
Committees on Information.
Committees on Sports.
Committees on Hall week.

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: COMMITTEE ON WELFARE
clauses: Shall be responsible to the Minister of Welfare.
Shall assist the Minister of Welfare in the discharge of his duty.
Shall be responsible for all matters pertaining to the Health of Hall members.
Shall be monitor prices goods and commodities at the Hall’s butteries to ensure that Hall members are not short changed.
Shall assist in making Transportation arrangements for Hall members during vacations.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Minister of Social and Welfare.
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the provisions of this constitution.

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: COMMITTEE ON SOCIAL AND INFORMATION
clauses: Shall be responsible to the Minister of social and Information.
Shall assist the Minister of Socials and Information in discharge of his duties.
Shall be responsible for the production of the Hall’s weekly bulletin, magazine, bulletin, publication or any other mode of communication in line with the university’s laws and regulations.
Shall liaise with the public Relations department of the University and any other relevant body or associated to aid it’s functions.
Shall be responsible for maintenance ad supervision of the common-rooms as well as reading rooms.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Minister of Information.
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the provisions of this constitution.

subsections.label: C
subsections.title: COMMITTEES OF SPORTS
clauses: Shall be responsible to the Minster of sports
Shall in conjunction with the Minister of sports supervise all sporting activities of the Hall.
Shall form time to time liaise with institutions/halls /bodies for Sport competitions.
Shall perform any other function as may be delegated by the Minister of Sports.
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the provisions the constitution.

subsections.label: D
subsections.title: COMMITTEES ON HALL WEEK
clauses: Shall be headed by the Minister of Welfare.
Shall be responsible for co-ordination of activities during the Hall Week.
Shall liaise with sponsors towards supporting the Hall week.
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the provisions of this constitution.

sections.title: DISSOLUTION OF A COMMITTEE
clauses: A committee shall be dissolved;
At the discretion of the Hall Chairman subject to 2/3 majority approval of Hall Executives.
On recommendation of the respective Executive officers to the Hall executives subject to 2/3 majority approval.

The Committee’s forum shall serve as a means of interaction between the Hall executives and Heads of the committees with a view to analyze the extent of progress, challenges and way forward on matters affecting the committees.

sections.title: COMPOSITION
clauses: The composition of Committee’s Forum shall be as follows;
All Heads of Committee
All Secretaries.
All members of the Hall Executive
The Hall Chairman shall preside over the forum while the secretary of the Committee on Social and Information shall be Secretary of the Committee’s forum.

sections.title: FUNCTIONS
clauses: The Committee’s forum shall;
Meet from time to discuss the extent of progress and challenges of each committee with a view to proffering solutions
Meet from time to time to assess the execution of the Hall’s budget.
Regulate the activities of the Committees
Perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the Hall Chairman.

articles.title: THE LEGISLATURE
intro: The Legislative arm of the Union shall be the Student Representatives Assembly (SRA) referred to in this constitution as The Senate shall be the law making body of the Union.

sections.title: COMPOSITION
clauses: The Student Representatives Assembly (SRA) shall consist of;
Two elected representatives from each of the respective Departments in the University save COLVET.
Four elected representatives from COLVET only
A representative each of International students and physically challenged students
Other members of the Union who shall have observer status

sections.title: FUNCTIONS AND POWERS OF THE SENATE
clauses: Shall be the law-making body of the Union
Shall make final approval of all decisions taken by the FEC as entrenched in this constitution and/or may be referred to it by the FEC

Shall pass resolutions which shall be binding on the Union provided. Such resolution(s) does (do) not violate the provision(a) of this constitution and is not in conflict with the University rules and regulations
Shall approve the nomination of the ordinary student representative(s) to the Student Court.
Shall be vested with power to set up Ad-Hoc committees as the need may arise to assist the senate in the discharge of its duties.

Shall have power to revert earlier decisions of the FUNAABSU Executive Council and that of an appointed officer of the Union and such decisions shall be binding on the FEC and the Senate save any decision made by the JCA.
Shall have the right to discipline any member of the organs of the Union who Defiles/contravenes the provisions of the Constitution.
Shall in cases of proven official corruption recommend the recovery of all gotten gains to the University authorities or the appropriate organ through the Senate President.

The President of the Student Union shall only withhold his signature for ten (10) working days to give assent to a Bill. Failure to do so, the Senate shall have power to veto such a Bill with a two-third (2/3) majority vote of members present at such sitting.

In the event that any elected or appointed officers of the Union fail to appear before the Senate provided that such an invitee(s) has been officially notified and invited, the Senate shall have the power to discipline such an officer.
Shall have the power to suspend or terminate transactions with the Union’s bankers on the recommendation of the FEC.
Shall have the power to appoint FUNAABSU Audit Committee to audit the Union’s account and such auditing exercise must be completed no later than two (2) weeks before the end of the academic session.
Shall have the power to suspend/impeach any officer of the FEC where found guilty of contravening the provision(s) of this constitution.
Shall exercise such powers as may be applicable within the provision(s) of this constitution.
Shall decide the third signatory to the account of the Senate among the other principal officers.
Shall have the power to perform oversight functions.

sections.title: OFFICERS OF THE SENATE
clauses: The Senate shall have the following officers to direct its affairs;
Senate President
Deputy Senate President
Clerk of the Senate
Deputy Clerk of the Senate
Sergeant-at-Arms

The election of the above shall be in accordance with the electioneering provisions and the standing orders of this constitution. For the purpose of the first meeting at which the above officers shall be elected, the Chairman of the FUNAABSU Independent Electoral Committee or his representative shall convene and preside over the meeting.

sections.title: ELIGIBILITY FOR MEMBERSHIP
clauses: Shall be opened to full-time ordinary members who must have a minimum CGPA of not less than 2.6 Meanwhile, the Senate President and the Deputy Senate President must have a CGPA of not less than 3.0. For the candidates who shall be in their second year in the constituencies undergoing a four-year discipline and Industrial Training during the third year, the minimum GPA of not less than 2.8 must be obtained for eligibility. The requirement for 400L candidates shall be the same 2.6 CGPA as earlier conspicuously stated
In addition to the Condition stated above. All members of the Senate
Must have a good knowledge of the Student Union constitution
Must not have been involved in any anti-union activities, misconduct, misappropriation of funds and fraud within and outside the University

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: SENATE PRESIDENT
clauses: The Senate President shall;
Convene and impartially direct the proceedings of ordinary sittings of the S.R.A
Convene emergency sittings of the Senate (a) at the request in writing of the FEC (b) at the request in writing of at least ½ member of the Senate (c) When the need arises

Give final direction and interpretation to all matters in the Senate revocable by a 2/3 majority vote of members present. The motion to revoke such decision(s) of the senate President shall be given as a point of order and shall be treated as urgent.
Shall be a co-signatory to the account of the Senate.

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: DEPUTY SENATE PRESIDENT
clauses: Shall assist the Senate President in discharging his duties at all times and deputise for him in his absence.
Shall draw the attention of the Senate President to cases of consistent absenteeism by members for the Senate president prompt action in forfeiting such seats.
Shall be the Chairman of the Senate Committee on Welfare and Business.
Shall automatically become the Senate President in the event that the Senate President becomes incapacitated or passed on.

subsections.title: C    CLERK
clauses: Shall perform the following function in consultation with the Senate
Issue notice of sittings
Prepare and circulate all papers and notice necessary for the transaction of the business of the Senate
Write the minutes of sittings and present same to the Senate for adoption.
Shall be the Chairman of the Information and Resolution Monitoring Committee of the Senate
Shall compile and present of the FEC an annual report of the S.R.A activities during his tenure of office.
Shall be a co-signatory to the SENATE account.

subsections.label: D
subsections.title: DEPUTY CLERK
clauses: Shall assist the Clerk in discharging his duties and deputise for him in his absence.
Shall be in charge of attendance taking in the Senate.
Shall carry out any such functions that may be assigned to him by the Clerk of the Senate
Shall carry out any other functions that may be assigned to him by the Senate President

subsections.label: E
subsections.title: SERGEANT-AT-ARMS
clauses: Shall maintain peace and order during sittings.
Shall formally announce the presence of the Senate president before any sitting
Shall carry out any other function(s) that may be assigned to him from time to time by the Senate President
In the absence of the Sergeant-at-arms, the Senate President shall appoint any member to act in his place.

sections.title: RIGHT OF ATTENDANCE, FORFEITURE OF SEATS, RESIGNATION AND BY-ELECTIONS AT SENATE SITTINGS
clauses: Only students of the University may attend sitting(s) of the Senate.
Person(s) referred to in S.34 (i) may be allowed by the Senate president to address the Senate.
A member of the Senate shall be deemed to have forfeited his/her seat in the Senate should he absent himself from two consecutive ordinary sittings without permission from the Senate President

A member of the Senate shall be deemed to have forfeited his/her seat if he becomes a member of the Executive/legislative arm in any academic association inclusive of indigenous association on campus.

An elected member shall be deemed to have forfeited his seat on the receipt of a demand to that effect signed by at least 2/3 of the constituency he represents provided that such member has been given a fair hearing.
A member desiring to resign his membership shall, in the first instance, do so in his constituency and shall thereafter inform the Senate President within Seventy-two (72) working hours.
A member of the Senate shall vacate his seat on ceasing to be a member of the Union

A member of the Senate shall vacate his seat temporarily or permanently as decided by a simple majority vote of the Senate on condition that such a member has been temporarily suspended or rusticated by the University.

The Clerk shall, through the FUNIEC, order that vacancy(ies) in the Senate arising from forfeiture of seat(s) or resignation be filled within a forth night from the date the Vacancy(ies) were declared.
The Senate President shall be removed from office on receipt of a notice of allegation signed by not less than 2/3 member of the Senate such a notice shall be submitted to the Clerk.
Motion for removal shall, on receipt by the Clerk, take priority over any other issue, the motion shall be heard within Seven (7) working days of its receipt by the Clerk.
A 2/3 majority vote of the Senate be required to remove the Senate President in such instance.
In the case of sub-section (x) above, the Deputy Senate President of the Senate shall preside.
Any officer responsible for the discharge of the provision on this section of the constitution shall ensure prompt compliance, failure of which shall constitute gross misconduct.

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: Ordinary sittings
clauses: The inaugural sitting of the Senate shall be held not later than seven (7) days after resumption of the first (1st) semester.
The sitting of the Senate shall be held at least three (3) times in a semester.
There shall be a Senate President or his Deputy presiding over all sittings of the Senate. In their absence, the Senate shall elect one of its members to preside.
The quorum for ordinary sittings shall be 1/3 of the members

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: Voting at sittings shall be by raising of hands except otherwise decided by a simple majority, or the presiding officer considers a secret ballot necessary.

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: Except otherwise provided by this constitution, all question(s), proposals shall be decided by simple majority votes of the members present at such sittings
clauses: The presiding officer shall cast the deciding vote in the event of a tie in line with the provision(s) of S. 41(iii) of the standing order.
Ordinary sittings of the Senate shall be summoned:
At the request in writing of the President.
At the discretion of the Senate President.
At the request in writing of 2/3 of the members.
B.Emergency sittings
The Senate President shall have the power to summon emergency sittings of the Senate:
Whenever the need arises in the interest of the Union
At the request in the writing of the FEC
At the request in writing of at least half (½) of members of the Senate

And notice of emergency sittings shall be conspicuously displayed on all notice boards, halls of residence and the Union’s secretariat at least six (6) hours before the time of sitting and such notice shall include the agenda of the sitting.
At such emergency sittings, the matters on the agenda for the sitting shall be given priority over other matters.
One third (1/3) members of the Senate shall constitute a quorum at emergency sitting(s)
Procedure of emergency sittings shall be the same as ordinary sittings of the Senate.

subsections.title: Standing Committees
clauses: Committee on Budget Monitoring and Finance
Committee on Welfare and business

subsections.title: Ad-hoc Committees
clauses: Committee on Budget and Appropriation

Subject to the provisions of this constitution, the Principal officers of the Senate shall in addition to the following set up such committees as may be deemed fit and shall have the power to remove members of the Committee.

articles.title: STANDING ORDER
intro: The provisions of this article are to guide the conduct of the Senate.

sections.title: ORDER OF THE BUSINESS
clauses: Unless the Senate resolves otherwise, the orders of business at any sitting shall be as follows:
In the absence of the Senate President and his Deputy, any of the members present shall be elected as the presiding officer for the sitting.
The Senate shall read and adopt the minutes of the last sitting.
Matters arising from the minutes of the last sitting shall be discussed unless such matter(s)have been reflected in the agenda of the sitting
Business shall be as specified on the agenda of the sitting and shall only be changed with the approval of the Senate President.
Any other business not specified on the agenda may be discussed with the express permission of the Senate President and or on the basis of simple majority.

sections.title: MINUTES BOOK
clauses: The Clerk of the Senate shall keep a minute book in which proceedings of sitting and other appropriate items shall be entered.
The minutes book shall kept in safe custody, and shall be made available for inspection on request by any member of the Senate

sections.title: ATTENDANCE REGISTER
clauses: The Deputy Clerk of the Senate shall keep an attendance register which shall be made available at every sitting and shall be duly signed all members attending the sitting

sections.title: QUORUM
clauses: i. The quorum of the Senate sittings shall be 1/3 majority of the members

ii. If a quorum is not formed within half an hour (30 minutes) of the time stipulated for a sitting of the Senate, the Senate President or any other person acting on his behalf may summarily declare such a sitting postponed

sections.title: VOTING PRIVILEGES IN THE SENATE
clauses: i.Every member except the Senate President shall be eligible to vote
ii.Voting shall be by raising of hands except otherwise decided by a simple majority or             by secret ballot if the Senate so decides

At the instance of a tie at the end of an election exercise, there shall be a second voting immediately, if the votes are still equal, the Senate shall go on recess and on resumption following another tie, the Senate President shall cast the deciding vote.

sections.title: MOTION AND AMENDMENTS
clauses: All motions to be debated shall be communicated in writing to the Clerk at least seventy-two (72) working hours before the next sitting. The notice of such motions shall be conspicuously displayed on all notice boards
Only motions(s) bearing the names of the mover and seconder shall be accepted and subsequently recorded. Such motion(s) upon acceptance shall be opened to discussion
Debate shall be limited to the immediate/pending issues as stated by the Senate President. The Senate President shall rule out of order, any person failing to the subject under discussion.

Preference shall be given to the motion/amendments first submitted where more than one motion/amendments are successively presented on any issue. Discussions on subsequent amendment or motion shall then follow.
Before a motion/ amendment is closed for debate, the mover of the original motion/amendment shall have the right to reply and after this. No other discussion on the topic shall be allowed.
All motions/ amendments under consideration as stated by the Senate President cannot be withdrawn without the consent of the mover.
In the course of discussion of a motion/ amendment, the following motions can be accepted in the order listed below;
a.Motion of no confidence on the Senate President
b.Motion withdrawing another motion.
c.Motion for adjournment.
d.Motion to revert the decision of the Senate President on the basis of 2/3 majority of members present.
e.Motion to close a debate.
f.Motion to ask question(s)
g.Motion to limit or extend a debate.
h.Motion for additional information.
i.Motion to refer an issue to a committee.
j.Motion to suspend standing order on the basis of simple majority of members present.
k.Motion for recess

viii. When a motion/ amendment has been put forward, the Senate President will make a list of the members who wish to speak for or against the motion/amendment. Such list shall be exhausted and closed after such speaker has been given five (5) minutes for his presentation. The principle of egalitarianism of debate shall be maintained during any discussion
ix. The Senate President shall recognize those wishing to speak in the following order of preference;
a.Point of order
b.Point of information
c.Point of observation
x.A point of order when raised must be heard at all times and shall deal with such matters as;
Indecorum
Intention to refer to standing orders and/or a clause of the constitution.
Violation of standing order(s)
Introduction of matter not relevant of the question under consideration
Digression from the matter under discussion
Willful disruption of business in the Senate
xi. Amendments shall be either by deleting or adding some words remove part/all of a sentence.

xii. When motion for closure has been moved and adopted, the Senate President shall make a list of those who want to speak on the condition that they have not spoken on the matter already. And five (5) minutes shall be allocated to each contributor. After everyone has been given the opportunity to speak once The Senate President shall be allowed a second chance of three (3) minutes duration and each contributor shall limit himself to answering questions or arguments raised in the course of the debate.
xiii. Proposal or motion for reconsideration of a motion previously adopted, shall be in order subject to 2/3 majority approval.
A resolution previously adopted may be reverted by majority vote provided that the Senate agrees to consider the matter.
SECTION 43:                        BILL PASSAGE
Stage 1
The first stage shall be the identification of the need for a Bill.
A Bill can be initiated by any ordinary member of the Union but only a Senator shall introduce it on the floor of the senate.
A Bill shall be in three categories: Executive, Member and Private Bills.
Stage 2: The second stage shall be divided into five
1st Reading: The Senate is generally introduced to the new proposed act which at this stage is called a Bill.
No debate on the Bill shall be done on the floor of the Senate at the first reading of the bill
The Bill shall be read and moved to the next stage if passed for second reading by The Senate or rejected if it fails to be passed
2nd Reading:
Only Bills passed at first reading shall be considered for second reading on the floor of The Senate.
Each clause of the Bill shall be deliberated at this stage of the Bill passage at the floor of the Senate.
Clauses contained in the Bill may be rephrased and amended by the Senate at this stage of the Bill passage.
The Bill shall move to the next stage if passed by the Senate and stand rejected if it fails to be passed by the Senate at this stage.
Committee stage:

Two committees of the Senate (Committees on Information & Resolution and Special Duties) shall deliberate on a Bill passed by the Senate at second reading, examines it more critically at this stage of the Bill passage.
Only the Ad-hoc Committee on Appropriations shall deliberate on an Appropriation Bill passed by the Senate at second reading, examines it more critically at this stage of the Bill passage.
The committees shall organize and conduct a Public hearing on the Bill at a date to be communicated by The Senate through the Clerk of the Senate.

3rd Reading: After the report of the Committee and deliberation of the Committee of the whole Senate, a motion may be moved that the bill be read the third time either immediately or at a later date and passed after the Senate has certified the contents of the clean copy to be accurate.
Assent by the President: Only bills that scaled through all the above stages of Bill passage shall be transmitted to the President for assent.
A bill shall become a law upon the accent of the President to such Bill.
The President shall have a maximum of ten (10) working days (starting from the date of receipt of such bill) to sign a bill into law or send back to the Senate for amendment.

The Senate shall be empowered to overrule the veto of the President if, after 10 working days, the President refuses to sign and assent the Bill and the Senate is not in support of the Presidential amendments.
The Senate is empowered to recall the bill and re-pass it.
Should the Presidential assent be vetoed by two-third majority vote in the Senate, the Bill automatically becomes a law even without the signature of the President.

articles.title: CODE OF CONDUCT FOR SENATE MEMBERS
intro: In furtherance of profound constitutional functions of the Senate, Federal University of Agriculture Abeokuta, Student Union and without prejudice to the provisions of this constitution, the Senate do hereby make and propose to ourselves the following rules.
RULE 3: Mode of attendance of Senate sittings

sections.title: RULE 1
clauses: The Official language of the Senate shall be English language. The Proceedings and debates of the Senate shall be conducted in English language.
Notwithstanding sub-section (i) above, any other language may be allowed subject to the permission of the Senate President.

sections.title: RULE 2
clauses: Conventionally as an intellectual and democratic legislator, a Senator shall dress formally to Senate sittings either in complete English dressing or native attires.
Any Senator who does not comply with the provisions of sub-section (i) above shall not be allowed to attend the sitting of such day and hence considered absent for such sitting.
The condition stated in sub-section (i) above shall not be enforced for emergency sittings.

sections.title: RULE 3
sections.text: Mode of attendance of Senate sittings
clauses: Every Senator shall sign-in not than thirty (30) minutes after the commencement of the day’s sitting and duly sign out when the sitting is brought to an end.
Any Senator who does not comply with the Provisions of sub-section (I) above shall be deemed absent for such sitting.

sections.title: RULE FOUR
clauses: During a sitting, all Senators shall enter the Senate with Decorum and can only leave with the permission of the Senate President.
All Senators shall properly put on their gowns during Senate sittings.

Senators shall not eat, drink, smoke or read newspapers, magazines, actively use mobile phones and all other digital equipments etc, in their seats except books and documents that are connected with business under debate.
During a sitting all Senators shall be silent, and may confer in undertones if the Senate President permits.
A Senator shall not make unseemly interruptions while another Senator is addressing the Senate.
While the Senate is in sitting, all Senator shall put their mobile phones in silent mode.
The Sergeant-at-arms shall recommend to the Senate President any violation of these rules for necessary disciplinary actions as stated in Article 4, section 43 (iii)

sections.title: RULE FIVE
clauses: Whenever the Senate President rises during a debate, any Senator, member of the FEC, or observer then speaking or offering to speak must sit down and the Senate shall be silent so that the Senate President may be heard without interruption.
In the case of grave disorder in the Senate, the Senate President may, at his discretion, adjourn the sitting without any question put forward or suspend the meeting for a time fixed by him

articles.title: THE JUDICIARY
intro: The Judiciary of the Union shall be referred to as the FUNAABSU Judicial Council (FJC). The FJC shall try cases that have to do basically with the operation of this Constitution provided such shall not be in conflict with any laid down University rules(s) and regulation(s). Should there be any conflict, the latter shall take precedence. It can also try cases emanating from affiliated/non- affiliated associations/clubs/societies that may be brought before it by any of the concerned party on campus.

sections.title: ELIGIBILITY FOR MEMBERSHIP OF THE JUDICIARY
clauses: Shall be open to full-time ordinary members who have a minimum CGPA of not less than 2.6 and 3.0 for the Chief Judge and fulfill any other constitutional provision for various judicial offices.
Every member of the FUNAABSU Judicial Council must have a good knowledge of the Student Union Constitution.
Every member of the FUNAABSU Judicial Council must not have been involved in any anti-union activities misconduct, misappropriation of funds and fraud within and outside the University.
Every member of the FUNAABSU Judicial Council must be a person of high personality and proven integrity

sections.title: ATHE STUDENT HIGH COURT

subsections.title: BTHE SUPREME STUDENT COURT
clauses: Shall be the highest court of the Union and shall be headed by the Chief judge of the Students' Union. The Supreme Student Court shall hear only appealed cases after the case must have been previously decided by the Student High Court. Only cases appealed not later than forty eight working hours after determination at the Student High Court shall be heard at the Supreme Student Court. It shall have the power to issue ex parte orders and court injunctions

This Court shall have the power to try case(s) brought before it. It is also empowered to try person(s), Officer(s), body/bodies, Club/societies affiliated/non-affiliated with the Union charged before it. It shall uphold social justice and shall defend the Constitution.
Try and determine cases of redress filed by registered member(s) against an individual or group(s).
Try and determine cases of violation of the constitution such as
Official corruption and/misuse of power on the part of present/past officers(s) of the union or committees/commissions.
Acts of indiscipline on the part of registered members of the Union.
Violation of the provision(s) of the constitution.

Try all matters referred to it by the FEC, Senate, the halls of residence executive cabinet, academic/indigenous associations on campus or any of the Union committee/commissions, of the affiliated clubs and associations.

sections.title: COMPOSITION OF THE FUNAABSU JUDICIAL COUNCIL
clauses: Each department shall produce a student barrister without contravening sub-section (iii)

The Outgoing FUNAABSU Judicial Council shall recommend the next Judicial Council Principal Officers to the FEC who shall then forward the (un-doctored) list to the Senate for ratification and confirmation.
There shall be a right of first refusal for barrister(s) who is/are not graduating and/or not going to be on campus for a period of three (3) months.

sections.title: OFFICERS OF THE FUNAABSU JUDICIAL COUNCIL

subsections.title: PRINCIPAL OFFICERS
clauses: Chief Judge
Two (2) Justices of the Student High Court.

Court Registrar
Court Bailiff
Court Orderly

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: NON PRINCIPAL OFFICERS
clauses: `Student Barristers

subsections.title: ACHIEF JUDGE
clauses: Shall be the head of the FUNAABSU Judicial Council (FJC)
Shall preside over the meeting of the FJC
Shall have power to discipline any member of the FJC through suspension.
Shall be the chief interpreter of the Student Union constitution.
Shall have the right to decide the appropriate punitive measure in the event where the Justice found any defendant guilty.
Shall be a core signatory to the FJC account.
Shall be in charge of all swearing-in of academic associations on campus.
Shall assign Justice to preside over cases at the Student High Court

subsections.title: BJUSTICES OF THE STUDENT HIGH COURT
clauses: There shall be two Justices of the Student High Court, they shall be appointed alongside with the other principal officers of the FJC. Their functions shall include the following
Shall have the right to listen to the testimony and evidence provided by the prosecution or defense.
Shall access the credibility of a witness.
Shall decide what the fact of any case(s) is/are.
Shall decide whether the accused is guilty or not guilty.
Shall carry out any other functions that may be assigned to him by the FJC

subsections.title: CTHE COURT REGISTRAR
clauses: Shall be the administrative officer of the FJC
Shall take charge of all correspondence of the FUNAABSU Judiciary Council
Take minute of meeting of the council and issue out circular of such minutes.
Shall perform other duties as may be assigned to him by the Chief Judge.
Shall be a co-signatory to the FJC account.
Shall carry out any other functions that may be assigned to him by the FJC

subsections.title: DCOURT BAILIFF

subsections.title: ECOURT ORDERLY
clauses: Shall be responsible for the maintenance of security in the court during proceedings.
Shall be vested with the power to excuse any member disturbing the peace and progress of the court proceedings.
Shall perform all such duties as may be directed by the Chief Judge.
Shall perform any other functions as may be assigned by the FJC.

subsections.title: FJUSTICES OF THE SUPREME STUDENT COURT
clauses: There shall be Three Justices of the Supreme Student High Court aside the Chief judge who shall head the Supreme Student Court.
Each of the justices must have served in either the SRA or the FJC to qualify for an appointment as a Justice of the Supreme Student Court.
Shall be appointed alongside the other principal officers of the FJC.
Their functions shall include the following:
Shall have the right to listen to the testimony and evidence provided by the prosecution or defense after a case decided by the Student High Court has been appealed at the Supreme Student Court.
Shall access the credibility of a witness.
Shall decide what the fact of any case(s) and appeal is/are.
Shall decide whether the accused is guilty or not guilty.
Shall carry out any other functions that may be assigned to them by the FJC

subsections.title: GSTUDENTS BARRISTERS
clauses: Shall act either as prosecuting or defense counsel on any matter(s) brought before the student court.

Shall be recommended to the principal officers of the FJC by 2/3 majority of executives of each departmental Association on campus, the names recommended shall be subjected to final ratification cum approval of  2/3 majority of a Senate sitting.
Shall belong to chamber(s) that is known, recognized and approved by the FJC. Each chamber shall decide its head and shall be subjected to the FJC
Shall be sworn-in by the incumbent Chief judge or his representative not later than five(5) working days after their confirmation by the Senate.
Shall perform any other functions as may be assigned by the FJC.
The head of each chamber shall present a periodical report of his chamber to the FJC meetings as may be required.

sections.title: POWER AND FUNCTIONS OF THE FUNAABSU JUDICIARY COUNCIL
clauses: The FUNAABSU Judiciary Council shall;
Give final interpretation of the provisions of this constitution.

Shall have the power to investigate any Justice/principal officers of the FJC on abuse of office, gross indiscipline, misconduct on the path of any member of the jury, any make its report\recommendation to the Senate through the legal commission with a view to maintain discipline.
Shall have the power to issue directives to the Justice with a view to uphold the standard of the judiciary.
The directive in (ii) above shall not however be contrary or limiting to the power/functions assigned to the jury by the provisions of the constitution.
2/3 of the FJC shall form a quorum at their meetings.
Decisions shall be based on simple majority.
Shall decide the third signatory to the FJC account.
Shall have the right to decide who should preside over the FJC meetings among the Justices in the absence of the Chief Judge

Any person who has/have held, is/her holding any office for the union to submit and give account to testify before the student court on his/her past and present official activities. However this shall hold when the need arises during the determination of a case in which the person(s) is/are involved.

Any of the affiliated clubs or associations, hall executive(s) or the Union’s established Commissions/Committees or other bodies and or office or individual members of such bodies shall appear before the Court as the need arises.
Have power to determine cases in absentia, of a defendant upon refusal to yield to summon(s) without convincing reasons.
Any registered member of the Union may attend the proceeding(s) of the case(s) before the Justice as observers except attendance is otherwise disapproved by the Justice.
The determination/judgement of a case by the Four (4) members of the justices of the Supreme Student Court shall be based on simple majority
The justices shall meet on judicial administrative matters or discussions outside judicial case determination function at least once in a month.
The deliberations, discussions or judgement of the Justice shall be based only on the provision of the constitution

sections.title: FORFEITURE OF SEATS, RESIGNATION AND REMOVAL OF FJC MEMBERS
clauses: Every member of the FJC shall be judged on personal merit. If any member’s integrity is   questionable such shall be prosecuted in the student court and he/she shall be suspended pending the determination of its case

Any member of the FJC who absents himself from duty in three consecutive cases without satisfactory reasons in writing to the FJC shall be deemed to have vacate his seat, and the FJC shall accordingly make arrangement for replacement subject to 2/3 majority ratification of the Senate.
Any member who wishes to resign his appointment shall communicate in writing to the FJC and send a copy to the SSRC and the Senate.

In the event, that there is a written petition which borders on corruption allegation(s) against any member of the FJC, such a petition shall be treated based on its merit by the FJC within five(5) working days. But if it is clearly established that the petition is lacking in merit, the alleged officer may take a legal action against the petitioner.

articles.title: JOINT CONSULTATIVE ASSEMBLY AND THE CONGRESS
intro: The Joint Consultative Assembly shall serve as a forum for all the organs of the Union to come together and deliberate on crucial issues affecting the union. The JCA shall meet as occasion demands but shall meet at least once in a semester.

sections.title: COMPOSITION
clauses: The JCA shall comprise of
Members of the FEC
Members of the Senate
Members of the FJC

sections.title: POWERS AND FUNCTIONS
clauses: The Joint Consultative Assembly shall;

Exercise the power of prerogative of mercy.
Shall declare a state of emergency in the union as may be required.

sections.title: STANDING ORDER
clauses: The Union President shall be the Chairman of the J.C.A while the Union General Secretary shall serve as the Secretary

At the request in writing of the FEC or.
At the request in writing of at least one-third members of the J.C.A

sections.title: COMPOSITION

The Congress shall hold at least two times in a semester.

sections.title: FUNCTION AND POWERS

sections.title: COMPOSITION
clauses: Each committee shall consist of five members headed by a chairman who shall be responsible to the relevant Director or Secretary.

Shall from time to time ensure that each affiliated club/society pays prescribed dues to the Union.

Shall help the Union in collection of member’s annual dues.

Shall supervise and co-ordinate the affairs of the Union butteries and cafeteria.
Shall handle all other commercial venture of the Union may be directed by the FEC.
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed Director of Welfare and Business.
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by provision(s) of this constitution.

Shall monitor the activities of the Union in general for appropriate information dissemination.
Shall carry out a thorough investigation on any information available to it
