Shall be responsible for the collection and preservation of research materials e .g journals
Shall liaise with research institutes for research advice and materials through the Research Centre of the University.
Shall organize academic seminars, symposia, lectures and workshops periodically.
Shall liaise with the Public Relations Unit of the University for necessary materials to aid its functions e.g. FUNAAB News bulletin, Academic publications, e. t. c
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the Director of Public Relations.
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the provision(s) of this constitution.
e. COMMITTEE ON SPORTS
Shall be responsible to the Sports Secretary.
Shall in conjunction with the Sports Secretary co-ordinate and supervise all sporting activities of the Union.
Shall from time to time liaise with institution(s) or body (ies) for Sports competitions.
Shall in conjunction with the Sports Secretary take proper care of all sporting materials.
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the Sports Secretary
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the Provision(s) of this constitution.
f. COMMITTEE ON SPECIAL DUTIES
Shall be composed of 2/3 membership of the FEC
Shall be responsible to the Office of the President
Shall be responsible for the receipt of petition arising from maltreatment of any student(s).
Shall be responsible for the welfare, promotion and discipline of the Union staffers.
Shall receive applications, forward name and recommend to the FEC
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the President.
Shall perform any other function(s) as may be directed by the provision(s) of this constitution.
g.        COMMITTEE ON ASSETS MANAGEMENT
There shall be an Assets Management Committee to be ratified by two-third (2/3) majority of members of the Senate.
The membership of the committee which shall comprise of three representatives each from all the organs of the Union.
shall be held responsible for all assets under its watch.
The committee shall have the power to determine its Chairman and Secretary
Shall seek to acquire new assets for the Union from time to time.
The President and the Chairman of this committee shall represent the Union at SUBMAC meetings.
The report of SUBMAC meetings shall be presented to the Senate as the needs may arise by the Chairman of the committee.

sections.title: DISOLUTION OF A COMMITTEE
clauses: A committee shall be dissolved;
At the discretion of the Union President
On recommendation of the respective officer(s) to the Union President

sections.title: CHAMBERS OF COMMITTEE
clauses: The Chamber of Committee shall serve as a forum for the FEC to interact with the Heads of Committees with a view to analyze and determine the extent of progress on matters affecting the Committees.

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: The compositon of the Chamber of Committee shall be as follows
clauses: All Heads of Committees
All Secretaries
All members of the FEC
The Assistant General Secretary shall be the Secretary of the Chamber of Committee.

sections.title: FUNCTIONS OF THE CHAMBER OF COMMITTEES
clauses: The Chamber of Committee shall;
Meet from time to time to discuss the problems of each committee with a view to evolving solutions.
Meet from time to time to assess the execution and monitoring of the Union’s budget.
Regulate the activities of the Committees
Perform any other functions as may be determined by the President.

articles.title: ELECTIONEERING PROVISIONS
intro: The Electoral Committee shall be referred to as the FUNAABSU Independent Electoral Committee (FUNIEC). The FUNIEC shall solely handle matters relating to elections shall be the responsibility and functions of the Union itself. However in ensuring fair Play and justice as well as orderliness the University will assist the Electoral committee with the administration and logistics of the Elections.

sections.title: COMPOSITION AND POWERS OF THE FUNAABSU INDEPENDENT ELECTORAL COMMITTEE
clauses: The FUNIEC shall consist of a representative from each college to be ratified and approved by The Senate not later than the middle of second semester for the purpose of conducting fresh elections.
The FUNIEC shall be a standing committee for one (1) academic year.
Only Senator from a college shall be eligible to nominate the member of FUNIEC representing such College.
Members of FUNIEC shall not be eligible to vote or be voted for.

The FUNIEC officer representing a College shall conduct Departmental Representatives elections (otherwise referred to as primary election) to the Senate. He/she shall be assisted by FUNIEC officers of other Colleges.
The Proposed budget/appropriation of FUNIEC shall be presented to the Senate by the President of the Student Union for approval for the conduct of general elections.
After election, FUNIEC will be subjected to FUNAABSU Audit Committee for proper audit
The FUNIEC in conjunction shall conduct Hall elections.
The FUNIEC shall forward Union election result to the Vice-Chancellor through the Dean of Student Affairs who shall arrange for the swearing-in of Union officers.
The FUNIEC shall exercise all other power function as directed by the provisions this constitution.
The FUNIEC shall issue a certificate of return winner(s) of election not later than one week after the conduct of such election.

sections.title: GENERAL ELECTION
clauses: Elections into the Senate shall be conducted on the basis of Departmental Representatives in a ratio of two (2) Representatives per Department save COLVET.
Elections into the Senate shall be held not later than three (3) weeks before the start of the second semester examinations.
Elections into the Halls Residence and FEC shall be held before and after elections into the Senate respectively.
All Union elections shall be by secret ballot or electronic system.
There shall also be regulation of an electronic system for the conduct of the Student Union general elections.
The e-election system in (v) above, shall consist of an e-voting and a corresponding e-accreditation.
A manual/paper accreditation system shall not be considered as fair and credible for an e-voting, but a corresponding e-accreditation system.

The e-voting and e-accreditation shall be designed to have as stored data, the list of all electorates who did accreditation and voted and the list of all electorates who did accreditation but did not vote.
The e-accreditation shall be designed in such a way that a unique ID/password shall be generated for every matriculation number that represents the identity of every electorate.
A unique ID/password mentioned in (v) above, shall be designed such that it shall not be utilized twice.
Software shall be designed to perform the tasks aforementioned.

sections.title: ELECTORAL PROCEDURES

subsections.title: B.CAMPAIGN ROVISIONS
clauses: Campaign shall starts as follows;
The Senate shall be one (1) week to elections while the FEC and Hall of Residence shall be two (2) weeks to elections.
Candidates can only begin their campaign after the FUNNIEC might have lifted the ban on campaign. Any violations shall amount to automatic disqualification of such candidate(s).
It shall be illegal for any candidates to campaign on Election Day. Such candidates or their agents shall be disqualified from voting in such election.
Manifesto night signifying the end of campaign shall take place on the evening of Election Day.
Only posters of contestants shall be legally displayed during campaign and election period. Writing on the walls of classrooms and Hall residence shall be illegal.
Any publication containing name/nickname, office, cabinet before lift of ban is tantamount to disqualification if found guilty after investigation upon a petition written to FUNIEC.

All aspiring candidates of any organ of the union found guilty of defacing either the school walls or public/private property (without authorization) with campaign messages/posters will be disqualified.
Campaign shall be governed by the guideline of FUNIEC.
The FUNIEC shall list names of candidate in alphabetical order and shall display same on notice boards and election centers not later than Twenty-four (24) hours before election.
Withdrawal of candidate shall be made not later than Forty-Eight hour before Election Day and such withdrawal shall be publicized on notice boards by the Electoral day.

All contestants shall be given a copy of the Constitution upon payment of fee prescribed for electoral forms and act in accordance with guideline and rules stipulated by the provisions of this constitution.
Each voter shall cast only one vote for each office, except if otherwise indicated e.g. multiple vacancies.
In upholding the principle of separation of power, candidates shall not be eligible to contest elections into both Legislative and Executive arm of government.
A student who shall not be available on the campus for at least six(6) weeks of his tenure  of office due to FPY, IT, etc, shall not be eligible to contest for any union office.
Counting of vote shall begin immediately after close of voting at the counting centers in the presence of accredited representatives or agents of each contestant.
Candidate shall be deemed to have won an election on the basis of a simple majority.
However, unopposed candidate must obtain half of the total votes cast before been declared to have won an election.
A bye-election shall be conducted in case of a tie in an election within seventy-two working hours after such election.
Where there is a vacancy, the second runner up or next in line to the winner shall be declared winner by FUNIEC.
FUNIEC shall issue Certificate of Return to all duly elected aspirants not more than one week after the conclusion of election.
Sales of forms must close officially before the commencement of screening exercise, and the list all aspirants who have purchased form must be publicized at least a day before the screening exercise.

sections.title: ELECTION REQUIREMENTS
clauses: A candidate must have spent one academic semester as an ordinary member of the Union to be eligible to vote and an academic session to be voted for.

For the purpose of elections into the Senate, candidates who shall be in their second year in the constituencies undergoing a four-year discipline and Industrial Training must have spent one academic semester to be voted for. The requirement for 300L candidates or 400L candidates in a 4-year or 5-year programme respectively with IT shall be the same one academic session as earlier conspicuously stated in (i) above.

A candidate must have been a registered member of the Union for at least one session except in the Senate in (ii) above. This shall be determined by proof of payment of annual dues during the said duration, failure of which shall lead to disqualification of the candidate from contesting any Union election post.
Must have a good knowledge of the Student Union constitution.
Must not have been involved in any anti-union activities, misconduct, misappropriation of funds and fraud within and outside the University.
A candidate contesting for the office of the President must have served in the union previously, any academics association or Halls of Residence on campus.
A candidate contesting for the office of the Speaker must have served in any legislative arm previously, on/other campus.

Any candidate among the Direct Entry students aspiring for the offices of the President and the Speaker must provide proof of service/certificate of office either in his previous institution or any public setting.
Candidates for all Union posts must have a minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (C.G.P.A) of 2.6 except for the principal officers who must have a minimum CGPA of 3.0

Contrary to (ix) above in the case of the elections into the Senate, candidates who shall be in their second year in the constituencies undergoing a four-year discipline and Industrial Training, the minimum GPA of not less than 2.8 must be obtained for eligibility. The requirement for 300L candidates or 400L candidates in a 4-year or 5-year programme respectively with IT shall be the same 2.6 CGPA as earlier conspicuously stated in (ix) above.
A past officer of the Union shall have the right to stand for re-election provided he/she has not been found guilty of any misconduct or abuse of office.

sections.title: ADJUDICATION PANEL
clauses: There shall be a five(5) man adjudication panel appointed by the Senate towards the end of second semester of every session.
The Chairman and Secretary shall be named by the S.R.A.
The members shall have the right ot vote but shall not be voted for.
The panel shall handle and treat all election petitions not later than Forty-Eight (48) hours of receipt of such petitions.
The panel shall receive election petitions not later than Forty-Eight hours after the last election.
The panel shall hear and determine all election petitions within five (5) days of receipt of such petitions.
All election petitions shall have no bearing on the swearing in of the affected officers until such petitions are determined.
Upon the decision of a panel, any affected officer(s) found guilty shall relinquish his office.
The outcome of all election petitions shall be made public and in writing to the Electoral Committee.
The panel shall stand dissolved seventy-two (72) hours after the determination of the last petition.

articles.title: TENURE OF OFFICE, DISSOLUTION AND RESIGNATION OF UNION OFFICERS

sections.title: TENURE OF OFFICE.
clauses: All officers of the Union shall serve for one session.
Any officer of the Union shall not be re-elected for more than one consecutive term.

sections.title: DISSOLUTION
clauses: All the organs of the Union shall stand dissolved a week before the start of the second semester examinations and all officers shall hand over Union properties in their possession in line with Article Twenty (107A).

sections.title: RESIGNATION OF UNION OFFICERS
clauses: Officers can resign from office by writing to the President of the Union and by sending a copy to the President of the Senate of the Union.

Any officer resigning from office shall render an account of his stewardship in writing to the President of the Union and he shall submit all Union properties in his custody within two weeks of such resignation to the General Secretary.
The President can resign from office by writing through the General Secretary to the Senate President and by sending a copy to the FEC.
Any officer of the Union resigning from office shall inform the University through the Dean of Student Affairs at least Forty-Eight hours before such resignation can take effect.

sections.title: SUSPENSION/IMPEACHEMENT OF UNION OFFICERS
clauses: A Union officer shall stand suspended upon a motion to its effect supported by 2/3 majority of members of the Senate after which investigations into the reasons where in the Officer was suspended shall be carried out.

Such Committee saddled with investigations shall carry out its assignment within two (2) weeks and if such officer is found guilty, shall be impeached from office by a 2/3 majority of members present at such sitting.

sections.title: THE UNION ACCOUNTS

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: There shall be a sub-account for the Senate and FJC respectively under the Union accounts.

clauses: The Union shall operate a current Account and there shall be three signatories to effect withdrawal from such account. The signatories shall be;
THE FEC
President
Director of Treasury
Director of Finance

sections.title: HALL ACCOUNT
clauses: The Halls Residence shall operate respective current account and there shall be three signatories to effect withdrawal from such accounts. The signatories shall be;
Chairman
Treasurer
Minister of Finance

sections.title: BUDGET AND EXPENDITURE

subsections.title: UNION BUDGET
clauses: The FEC through the Office of Director of Finance shall prepare a budget of the Union and the President shall present same to the Senate for approval within fourteen (14) days on assumption of office. Supplementary budget may be raised when the need arises but must be approved and ratified by 2/3 majority members of a Senate sitting after due consideration and presentation by the Ad-hoc Committee on Budget and Appropriation.

subsections.title: HALL BUDGET
clauses: The Hall budget shall be prepared by the Minister of Finance in consultation with other Hall executive members.
All expenditure of the organs of the Union shall be strictly based on the approved budget and appropriation except otherwise reviewed by 2/3 majority approval of the Senate.

The annual budget of the Union shall be published on the Union notice boards by the Director of Finance not later than Seventy-two (72) working hours after approval by the Senate. Such approval budget shall be compiled in two copies;
A copy to be given to the Clerk of the Senate
A copy to be retained by the Director of Finance on behalf of the FEC.

sections.title: SOURCES OF INCOME
clauses: Union income shall be obtained from the following source:
Membership dues as may be decided by FEC.
Remittance from other bodies of the Union.
Donations made to the Unions
Grants from the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta. If any
Profits accruing from Union business activities
Grants made by institution, corporations or individuals in aid of the Union’s activities excluding grants from political organizations.
Surcharge of members of the Union.
Any other fund coming from other sources.

sections.title: PROCEDURE FOR RECEIPT AND DISBURSEMENT OF FUNDS
clauses: All vouchers, purchase Orders and other relevant document shall be signed first by the spending officer (s) then the Director of Finance and the President shall countersign before payment is made by the Director of Treasury
The Director of Treasury shall accept stamped and duly signed receipts for all funds disbursed.
The Director of Treasury shall issue stamped and fully signed receipts for all funds received by Him.
Loan agreements between the Union and affiliated clubs shall be signed by the signatories to the Union’s Account on the part of the Union.
An impress amount of not more than Ten thousand naira (N300,000) shall be kept by the Director of Treasury.

sections.title: ALLOWANCE
clauses: Any member of the Union on official duty shall be entitled to an out-station over-night allowance as follows:-
The President shall be entitled to Three Thousand five hundred naira (N3, 500.00) per night.
The other Principal Officers of the Union shall be entitled to Three Thousand naira (N3, 000.00) per night.
The key officers of the Union shall be entitled to Two Thousand Naira only (2,000.00) per night.

sections.title: AUDITING OF THE UNION ACCOUNT
clauses: There shall be a FUNAABSU Audit Committee (FAC) consisting of five ordinary members of the Union.
The five ordinary members shall be appointed by the Senate subject to its 2/3 majority approval.
The account of the Union shall be submitted for audit at least once a year by the Director of Finance as requested by the FUNAABSU Audit Committee.
Such audit exercise shall be completed no later than a month before the dissolution of the Union.
The FUNAABSU Audit Committee shall be given a written terms of reference and condition of appointment by the appointing organ.
The FUNAABSU Audit Committee shall ensure that all auditing processes are continuous.

The FUNAABSU Audit Committee shall be empowered to summon any member of the Union to submit at a stated place, period and time, the account records of the Union and any other information in his custody.
The audited report shall be presented to as a session of the Senate by the Chairman of the panel at the 3rd to the last sitting of the Senate.
The audited report shall be published by the Director of Finance or the Clerk of the Senate not later than 72 Working hours after the date of ratification of the Senate.

articles.title: KEY AND PRINCIPAL OFFICERS OF THE UNION
intro: There shall be principal and key officers of the Union comprising of the following under listed.

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: The Principal Officers of the Union
clauses: President
Vice President
Senate President
Chief Judge

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: The Key officers of the Union
clauses: Other elected Union officers
Other appointed Union officers.

sections.title: CLUBS AND SOCIETIES
clauses: May be affiliated to the Student Union except otherwise indicated by this constitution.
Shall be divided into two categories:
Clubs and Societies formed, supported and sponsored by the Union and registered with the University.
Clubs and societies formed independently self-supported and registered with the University.

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: Any Club/Society to be affiliated to the Union
clauses: Must have its primary objectives the intellectual and socio-cultural development of the students.
Shall submit two copies of its constitution to the committee on Socials and Clubs.

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: The Committee for Social and Clubs shall have power to reject and withdraw any affiliated Club/Society subject to the approval of the FEC.
clauses: iii. Shall not be constituted on the basis of religious, ethnicity and political considerations.

sections.title: PROCEDURE FOR AFFILIATION
clauses: The Union may affiliate Club(s), society(ies) and renew their affiliation annually.
All Clubs/Societies seeking affiliation shall pay an affiliated fee of a stipulated amount as may be prescribed by The Senate.
Other criteria for affiliated Clubs/Societies may be prescribed by The Senate.

sections.title: PRIVILEGES OF AFFILIATION
clauses: Affiliated Clubs and Societies shall:
Make use of the Union’s facilities from time as may be determined by the FEC.
Enjoy full Union patronage.
Have the right to summon and be summoned before the Students Union Court.
Send representatives to defend or inform any organ or unit of the Union.

sections.title: REGULATION GOVERNING AFFILIATION
clauses: Application for the renewal of affiliation of clubs/societies shall be forward to the Committee for Social and Clubs annually.
Any affiliated Club/Society proposing a Social function shall give a prior notice of at least Forty Eight (48)hours to the FEC through the Committee for Social and Clubs for use of Union facilities.

The Commission for Social and Club shall be responsible for the settlement of disputes within and between affiliated Club(s) Society(ies) provided such dispute are not before any of the student court or any university committee.
Affiliated Clubs/Societies shall be entitled to loans pavable within one academic session.
Only Clubs/Societies with an outstanding record of financial commitment to the Union shall have access to the Union loan, on a normal interest rate of 5% cover administrative cost.
There shall be Guarantor(s) before such loan can be granted.
The guarantor(s) account/status shall be commensurate with the loan.
Other conditions for taking and paying such loans shall be determined by the FEC.
The affiliated Clubs/Societies shall enjoy other privileges as may be determined by the FEC.
All Clubs/Societies seeking affiliation or renewal shall forward its annual report of activities to the Union through the Committee for Social and Clubs.
Affiliated Clubs/Societies shall forward the names of their members ad executive member to the Committee for Social and Clubs for on ward transmission to the FEC.

articles.title: RELATIONSHIP OF THE UNION WITH OTHER BODIES

sections.title: RELATIONSHIP OF THE UNION WITH OTHER BODIES
clauses: a. The Union shall:
Maintain cordial relationship with other student bodies in all Educational Institution of Nigeria and other International bodies.
Maintain cordial relationship with other bodies at both National and International level.
The relationship I and II above shall be in the best interest of the Union.

sections.title: RECOGNITION OF EXTERNAL BODIES
clauses: The central executive of the FEC shall present a proposal to consider such cordial relationship or otherwise to the Senate for simple majority approval.

The Union shall always rise to clarion national, international or otherwise, progressive calls provided such are in the interest of the Union and shall not be contrary to the constitutional provision(s) of The Federal Republic of Nigeria.

articles.title: UNION ACTIVITIES
intro: All the activities of the Union shall be within the provisions of this constitution.

sections.title: The activities of the Union shall include
clauses: a. The Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta Student Union week shall be an annual event and shall be coordinated in the second (2nd) semester of every session.
It shall be supervised and fully coordinated by the Union’s Vice President.
The Committee on Socials and Clubs and other Union bodies as may be decided by the FEC shall be deeply involved in the planning and/or execution of the programmes of the Student Union Week.
Membership of the Union week committee shall cut across all the organs of the Union and approved by a simple majority of a Senate sitting.

b. Other activities which have been entrenched in this constitution including Fund Raising activities, Self-help projects, Foundation Day activities, Day-to-Day activities and other activities may be determined by the FEC but shall be ratified and approved by the Senate.

sections.title: REPORT OF UNION ACTIVITIES
clauses: There shall be periodic report of all the union activities by the FEC.
There shall be periodic conference which shall serve as:
An avenue for communicating the decision/activities of the Union to the public.
Forum for open dialogue.
Newsletters shall be issued periodically and shall be:
Circulated among Union members within the financial limit of the Union.
Circulated to relevant bodies.
Other modes of communication as may be determined by the FEC may be established.

sections.title: PUBLICATION OF UNION ACCOUNT
clauses: The audited account of the Union shall be displayed publicly by the Director of Finance at least once a session on all Union Notice Boards.

articles.title: SELF-HELP PROJECT
intro: There shall be a self-help project committee charge with responsibility of initiating, monitoring and executing the self-help project(s).

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: The Self-Help project committee shall comprise:
clauses: President
Deputy Senate President
Director of Socials
Director of Welfare and Business
A representative of the FJC
Two (2) representatives of the Students (Ordinary members).
B    The President shall be the Chairman of the Committee.

subsections.label: C
subsections.title: The Committee shall be empowered to appoint its Secretary.

sections.title: SOURCE(S) OF FINANCE OF SELF-HELP PROJECTS
clauses: Self-Help project shall be financed through:
Voluntary Donation from Student

Donation from Institution(s), Educationist(s), Philanthropist(s), Government Agency(ies), Association(s), Club(s), Society(ies), Firms, etc provided such donation shall not indicate and/or express any obligation whatsoever on the part the Union or the University authority.

sections.title: POWER AD FUNCTIONS
clauses: The Secretary of the Committee shall be elected at its first sitting to be convened by Union President.
The Committee shall regulate its own procedure.
Shall manage the production of souvenirs
The Committee shall inaugurate Self-Help project(s) such as:
The Extension/Renovation unit of the Union Building.
Building of the Union’s/student’s Hall of Residence.
Any other self-Help project(s) may be determined by the committee.
Any other project(s) as may be directed by FEC and or The Senate.

articles.title: FUNAABSU EMPOWERMENT COMMISSION
intro: The FUNAABSU Empowerment Commission shall be constituted to necessitate the Constitution to see to the Empowerment of the indigent students, the entrepreneurial students and the progress and advancement of the entire student populace to become independent and employers of Labour after school

sections.title: COMPOSITION
clauses: Shall be headed by a Director which shall be nominated by the FEC, subject to 2/3 majority approval of members of the Senate at that sitting.
Shall comprise of at least seven members which may be increased if the need arises.
May also be sub-divided into units if the need be at the discretion of the director subjected to the approval of the union president.
Shall report all her affairs directly to the union president and/or the Senate at intervals/at request.

sections.title: FUNCTIONS AND POWER OF THE COMMISSION
clauses: Shall on behalf of FUNAABSU liaise with FUNAAB CENT and CENIP in the interest of our students
Shall organize empowerment and entrepreneurial programs, training, summits, seminars on behalf of FUNAABSU.
Shall recommend to the union, indigent students who need full or partial sponsorship based on accreditation (either by the university students affairs division or the commission itself).
Shall behalf of FUNAABSU liaise with Governmental and Non-Governmental bodies, philanthropist and donor (in line with FUNAABSU constitution) to empower students on various vocational fields.
Shall on behalf of FUNAABSU search and discover gifted hands and talented student for the purpose of empowerment and encouragement.
Shall perform any other duty assigned to it by officer(s) of the union or provision of the constitution.

articles.title: FUNAABSU TASK FORCE COMMISSION
intro: The FUNAABSU Task Force Commission shall be constituted to enable the constitution to enhance the enforcement of laws made by the three organs of the union with respect to FUNAABSU constitution and FUNAAB Rules and Regulations.

sections.title: FUNCTIONS AND POWERS OF THE COMMISSION
clauses: Shall be an additional labour force for the union.
Shall serve as the law enforcement agency of the union thereby complementing law making.
Shall aid the activities/functioning of the information and resolution monitoring committee of the Senate.
Shall see to it that offenders punished according to the law either by the judiciary/legislative arm, carry out such punishment(s).
Shall compliment the effort of the director of welfare and business, and the Senate committee on transportation,.
Shall perform other duty assigned to it by the officer(s) of the union in accordance to the FUNAABSU constitution.

sections.title: COMPOSITION
clauses: Shall be headed by a chairman
Shall comprise of minimum of 7 members and maximum of 21 members depending on the level of needs arising.
Members of the commission shall be nominated by the principal officers of the union and ratified by the simple majority members of the Senate present at such sitting.
Members of the commission shall be ordinary members of the union.
Shall report to any organ of the union/any officer of the union depending on the concerned matter in line with FUNAABSU constitution.

articles.title: STUDENT LOAN REGULATION
intro: The Student Loan Regulation seeks to provide guidelines and procedure for the issuance of loans to the ordinary members and officers of the FUNAAB Student Union

sections.title: STUDENT LOAN ISSUANCE GUIDELINES AND PROCEDURE.
clauses: All or any ordinary member and officer of the union who wishes to obtain for himself/herself a loan from the Student Union shall make an application for such loan to the president of the Union with an acknowledgement from the DSA.

The President shall then direct the General Secretary and Director of Finance of the Union to prepare documents relevant to the issuance of such loan. The documents shall include a signed agreement to return the loan within a stipulated time not later than the third week of second semester.
The Director of Finance shall issue a loan form which must be filled by the student intending to obtain loan from the Student Union.

The president of the Union shall then write to the Senate for final approval on the issuance of the loans. The President shall along the letter attach all relevant documents and a copy of the loan form for the Senate perusal.
No loan above thirty thousand Naira shall be issued.
There shall be punitive measures against students who fail to return their loans as determined by the Senate with the help of the Student Affairs.

subsections.label: A
subsections.title: HANDING OVER
clauses: All elected and appointed Union officers shall hand over ALL Union properties in their possession to the newly sworn-in Student Union and Halls of Residence officers.
Such handing over shall be done immediately after the oath of office has been instituted on every new officer of the Union/Halls.

For the purpose of Article Twenty (S107A), if the Student Union general election has not been held as at the end of the session and the Principal officers as recognized by Article Twelve (88A) will cease to be Union members by the following session, they shall handover all Union properties in their possession to the most senior key officer of the Union who shall head an INTERIM GOVERNMENT to be constituted by the JCA.
The Interim Government shall serve for the period till the Student Union general election holds. Such general election shall be held no later than one month after the commencement of the new session.

subsections.label: B
subsections.title: SWEARING-IN CEREMONY
clauses: This shall be a ceremony where deserving officers, any ordinary members be given award of merit and elected officers sworn-in by the Vice-Chancellor.

subsections.title: STUDENT UNION OFFICERS
clauses: The ceremony shall be performed in order stated below:
Dissolution of the outgoing elected officers by the Dean, Student Affairs
Swearing-in of the elected officers starting with the Principal Officers of the Union followed by the other elected officers of the FEC, Senate and FJC by the University lawyer or his representative.
Presidential address by the newly sworn-in President.
Senate Presidential address by the newly sworn-in President of the Senate.
Award of Certificate for the outgoing officers of the union.
Address by the Vice- Chancellor.
Closing by the Student Affairs Officers

subsections.title: HALLS OF RESIDENCE OFFICERS
clauses: There shall be a swearing-in ceremony for the elected executives of both the Male and Female Hall of Residence by the Male and Female Hall Wardens and shall be addressed by the Dean, Student Affairs.
The Dean, Student Affairs in conjunction with the Hall Wardens shall issue out certificate of office to the outgoing executives shortly after their dissolution.

subsections.title: MEMBERS OF COMMITTEES
clauses: The Committee member shall be sworn-in by the President of the Student Union.

articles.title: APPOINTMENT OF STUDENT REPRESENTATIVES ON UNIVERSITY COMMITTEES

sections.title: APPOINTMENT OF STUDENT REPRESENTATIVES ON UNIVERSITY COMMITTEES
clauses: Appointment of student representatives shall be done by the FEC among the Union Officers and approved by a simple majority of the Senate.

sections.title: AMENDMENT OF THE CONSTITUTION

subsections.title: OATH OF OFFICE
clauses: (To be completed in triplicate by both elected and appointed officers)

I Mr/Mrs/Miss………………………………………………….of College of ……………………Do hereby solemnly swear and accept the office of …………………… of the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta Students’ Union, declared as follows:

The provisions of this constitution or part of it shall be subject to amendment as follows:

A motion for amendment shall be in written form and shall bear the name of the mover and the seconder and shall be submitted to the clerk of the Senate at least seven (7) days before the next sitting of the Senate.
Such motion for amendment shall be displayed on all notice boards by the clerk of the Senate at least five (5) days before sitting.
No amendment shall be made on partisan interest.
A motion for amendment shall be effected by approval of 2/3 members of the Senate at a sitting summoned exclusively for the purpose.
The amended part of the constitution shall be communicated in writing to the University through the Dean, Student Affairs not later than forty-eight (48) hours after such amendment for approval.
The amendment as approval by the University shall be displayed on all notice boards by the clerk of the Senate.
